Do you want to make a real impact by driving DevOps transformation in a fast-growing software company?

**Your new role

**As a DevOps Specialist in the Developer Enablement team at Dalux, you will play a key role in improving the developer experience and increasing productivity as we continue to scale. Your focus will be on building, evolving, and maintaining our CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure, while promoting DevOps best practices and strong software engineering principles across the organization.

You will work closely with development teams to ensure that our platforms and tooling effectively support a wide range of technologies and product areas.

**Your Responsibilities

**In this role, you will:

• Continuously improve development at Dalux by proposing and implementing new ideas and evolving our systems to better support developers

• Clarify requirements and define technical and architectural solutions in collaboration with team members

• Coach and train internal users (our developers) in using the platforms and tools we provide

• Release, operate, and maintain internal components and products

• Explore, experiment, and research new technologies to identify opportunities for technical improvement

**Our DevOps platform and tech stack

**We aim to build reliable, repeatable, and highly automated pipelines, configured and maintained as code. Our shared and customizable build systems support a broad range of teams — from mobile and web applications to image processing and backend services.

Our primary technologies include:

• Jenkins (Jenkins Pipelines, JCasC)

• GitLab and Nexus (self-hosted)

• Docker

• Hyper-V

• Prometheus, Thanos and Grafana

• MSBuild

• NPM (pnpm and Vite)

• AWS (EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, CloudFormation, S3 etc.)

Builds and tests are orchestrated using Jenkins, with code hosted in GitLab. Our platforms run on both Linux and Windows.

Dalux’ continuous growth makes the environment exciting and ever changing, but is also one of the reasons why our DevOps discipline is behind where we would like it to be.

Alongside the Developer Enablement team, we have a large DevOps Guild that supports the rollout of best practices and knowledge sharing across Dalux. Our development culture is pragmatic and agile, with frequent releases. We apply the same pragmatism to DevOps — once value is demonstrated, we move quickly to implement changes.

**Your background

**We expect that you have an educational background in Software Engineering. In addition, you have either been part of driving DevOps transformations previously and see DevOps as your strongest asset. We have open positions for both experienced DevOps profiles and developers who want to specialize further in DevOps.

**Ready for the next step?

**If Dalux sounds like a place where you could make an impact while continuing to grow as a developer, we would be happy to receive your application. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact **IT Talent Acquisition Specialist, Nicole Przybylski +45 71 74 01 31

**This position is open on an ongoing basis due to our continuous growth. We hire multiple candidates throughout the year and keep the position open to ensure we attract the right talent as we expand.

**About Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Ph.D. Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard. Our products are designed to make the construction industry smarter and more efficient.

Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly digital tools that are used in more than 140 countries worldwide. We are passionate about modern technology and proud to be first movers in applying new technologies - all developed entirely in-house at Dalux.

About the job

Pelvic organ prolapse affects millions of women, yet many are still left choosing between inadequate conservative options and invasive procedures. Sylvia Health has developed a new medical device designed to offer better support, dignity and quality of life for women living with rectocele prolapse, a major subtype of pelvic organ prolapse.

We are now looking for a Commercial Lead, potentially as a co-founder, to help bring this solution to market. This is a unique opportunity to shape the commercial future of an early-stage women's health company tackling a large, under-served and meaningful problem.

About Sylvia Health

Sylvia Health has developed a novel Class I/IIa medical device for rectocele prolapse support, designed to address an urgent unmet need in pelvic health.

Our aim is to improve quality of life for women who need better options between conservative management and invasive intervention. The product has been developed with a focus on real-world use, comfort, dignity and scalability.

We have developed and patient-tested a medical-grade product, and have recently completed our clinical study at Herlev Hospital. Although we cannot share the full results ahead of publication, we are excited by what we have seen and believe we have developed a compelling solution for the unmet need we set out to address.

We are now focused on preparing regulatory submission, expanding our team, and taking the product to market within the next 18 months. The company is supported by technical and clinical expertise, alongside a strong network of clinical and industry advisors.

Why now

Sylvia Health is entering a pivotal phase. The device has been developed and clinically tested, significant funding is in place, and we now need the right commercial co-founder to help shape the path from developed medical device to successful market entry.

This role is a founder-level opportunity to help define the commercial strategy, positioning, partnerships and market access pathway for a new category in women's health.

The role

As Commercial Lead / Co-founder, you will drive Sylvia Health's go-to-market strategy and play a central role in the company's growth.

You will work closely with the founding team, board, clinical advisors and technical partners to translate a patient-centred medical device into a credible, scalable commercial opportunity.

Key responsibilities

• 
Develop and execute a comprehensive go-to-market strategy

• 
Shape market positioning, pricing, branding and distribution strategy

• 
Build relationships with healthcare providers, hospital decision-makers, distributors and strategic partners

• 
Help define market access and reimbursement considerations across key markets

• 
Collaborate with technical and clinical functions to ensure product-market alignment

• 
Contribute to fundraising activities, investor conversations and strategic planning

What we are looking for

We are looking for someone with relevant commercial experience in medical devices/MedTech, combined with the judgement and appetite to help build an early-stage company.

Relevant experience may include:

• 
Medical device commercialisation

• 
MedTech go-to-market strategy

• 
Healthcare sales, partnerships or business development

• 
Pricing, distribution, market access or reimbursement strategy

• 
Working with hospitals, healthcare providers or medical device distributors

• 
Major medical device markets, especially Europe

• 
Early-stage company building, fundraising or investor relations

We do not expect one person to have done everything. We are looking for a commercially minded, mission-aligned operator who can help shape the opportunity.

Desired qualities

• 
Entrepreneurial mindset suited to an early-stage startup environment (essential)

• 
Strong strategic judgement and willingness to operate hands-on

• 
Ability to build trust with clinical, commercial and investor stakeholders

• 
Interest in women's health and under-served patient needs

• 
Collaborative working style and appetite for a true co-founder relationship

• 
Full-time availability preferred, though a part-time role may be possible for the right candidate

What we offer

• 
Significant equity package aligned with a true co-founder contribution

• 
Founder-level influence over company strategy, market entry and commercial direction

• 
Opportunity to help build a new category in women's health

• 
A meaningful role in improving care for women affected by pelvic organ prolapse

• 
A team with technical and clinical expertise, supported by experienced clinical and industry advisors

• 
Developed, patient-tested medical-grade product with an expected 12-24 month time to market

• 
Salary negotiable within typical MedTech startup ranges

• 
Position available immediately, with start date no later than Q1 2027

• 
Flexible location. While we are based in Copenhagen, remote work is possible for the right candidate

Application process

We would like to begin with an informal conversation. Please email your expression of interest and relevant background to Andrew (join@sylvia.health). From there, the process would likely include:

• 
An informal coffee meeting or call

• 
Candidate shortlisting based on experience and alignment

• 
Final conversation with co-founders and board

If you have any questions, please contact Sameer Ahmed (Senior Manager, Equipment Maintenance and Calibration) on +45 50106391 or on LinkedIn. jobs.description:
Are you ready to apply your engineering, project leadership and sourcing expertise to the world of product development and manufacturing? Join us as Senior Project Manager in Design for Value (DfV) and impact the way we design, develop, and manufacture products at GN Hearing in Ballerup.

The team you will be part of:

Based at our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Design for Value team in Global Manufacturing & Operations, reporting directly to Director René Bergqvist.

In this role, you will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders worldwide, ensuring value and cost are managed effectively and optimized in our products from the early concept phase through to mass production.

Your contribution is appreciated and you will:

• Optimize products by supporting the organization with cost / value analysis in our products, modules, platforms and architecture

• Investigate and motivate for cost-effective design and manufacturability, e.g. via mapping of value / cost opportunities related to roadmap, product, and design options

• Manage cost targets and running estimate for ramp up in development projects

• Facilitate and support project sourcing activities including availability reviews, supplier selection, RFQs, and negotiations

• Support building positive business cases together with R&D & Product Marketing

• Facilitate and conduct project reviews related to Design for Value, Cost and Manufacturing

• Follow up and guard the cost in product development by working with R&D on their suggested specification, manufacturing or material selection

You will also work on introducing new technologies and innovations during product development and play a key role in approving targets and results before critical milestones are passed.

You will also support key cross-functional projects that are part of strategic initiatives (“must-win battles”) with significant value or savings impact from an Operations and Sourcing perspective.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you - besides having a technical mindset and a good business understanding - have:

• A degree or similar within engineering, preferably within electronics

• Experience within platform and product development, supplier sourcing or cost/value optimization in a R&D environment are positive differentiators

• Good at solving both technical and commercial issues

• General understanding of manufacturing processes and industrialization

• Experience with LEAN, Design for Value/Cost, or supplier sourcing in Asia, are positive differentiators

• Presentation, negotiation, and communication skills in English, both written and spoken

In addition, you have an engaging personality and possess facilitation skills, enabling you to build networks and engage stakeholders. You also possess solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, which you use to identify issues and propose effective solutions.

You are, furthermore, steadfast and enjoy working in a multicultural, changing environment. You take initiative and, most importantly, follow through on the initiatives you start.

We offer:

• A unique opportunity to grow and gain experience across both engineering and business

• A supportive and dynamic work environment where you can learn to navigate change with confidence

• Opportunities for professional and personal growth in a top-tier global high-tech company.

• The chance to contribute meaningfully to GN

• An international and collaborative workplace

We encourage you to apply

We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that align with our core values, to not only ensure your growth, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the Interview please let the hiring manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 25 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our leading intelligent hearing, inspired by people and driven by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss overcome real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Are you passionate about delivering great customer experiences and solving technical challenges?

At Trackman, we are looking for a service-minded and technically curious Customer Service Specialist to join our Business Tools Support team.

In this role, you will be a key point of contact for customers worldwide, helping them get the most out of our innovative sports technology. From troubleshooting technical issues to guiding new customers through onboarding, you will play an important role in delivering a seamless and professional customer experience.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where customer satisfaction, problem-solving, and continuous improvement are at the heart of what we do.

Meet the Team

You will join our Business Tools Support team in EMEA, a collaborative team of six supporting the digital platforms and services used by Trackman venues worldwide, including Booking & Payments, the Trackman Portal, and venue onboarding.

Working closely with customers, Sales, Product, and Development, the team resolves technical and operational challenges and continuously improves our solutions. You will have the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge, support international customers, and contribute to delivering excellent customer experiences.

What will you be doing?

As a Customer Service Specialist, you will combine customer service with hands-on technical support. Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone and email, providing professional, friendly, and efficient assistance.

• 
Technical Troubleshooting: Identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues related to Trackman products, software, and connected devices.

• 
Customer Onboarding: Guide new customers through product setup, configuration, and usage, ensuring they feel confident using our solutions.

• 
Product Guidance: Educate customers on product features, updates, and best practices to help them get the most out of Trackman technology.

• 
Case Management: Handle multiple support requests, prioritize effectively, and maintain accurate documentation in our support system.

• 
Follow-up & Customer Satisfaction: Proactively follow up on customer cases to ensure successful resolutions and positive experiences.

• 
Collaboration & Improvement: Work closely with colleagues and other departments to resolve complex issues, share knowledge, and continuously improve our support processes.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who enjoys helping people, has a natural interest in technology, and thrives in a dynamic, international environment.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
Previous experience in customer service, technical support, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably within a technology-related industry.

• 
Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

• 
A customer-focused mindset with excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.

• 
Confidence working with Windows operating systems, computers, and common technical devices such as monitors, projectors, and mobile devices.

• 
Experience with ticketing or customer support systems, preferably Zendesk.

• 
The ability to manage multiple requests, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high level of service in a busy environment.

• 
A proactive, structured, and collaborative approach to your work.

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• 
An interest in sports, particularly golf, baseball, or sports technology.

• 
Basic knowledge of networking and connectivity.

• 
Experience with remote troubleshooting and technical diagnostics.

• 
Additional education or training in IT, customer service, or a related field.

• 
Flexibility to work weekends when required.

Most importantly, you are curious, eager to learn, and motivated by making a difference for customers.

What can we offer?

At Trackman, you will become part of an international technology company where innovation, sports, and passion come together.

You will have the opportunity to work with advanced sports technology used by athletes, coaches, and organizations worldwide, alongside talented and dedicated colleagues.

We offer a collaborative working environment, opportunities to develop your technical and customer service skills, and a culture where initiative, ownership, and new ideas are valued.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

If you are excited about combining technology, customer service, and sports, we would love to hear from you!

For additional information about the position, please contact Jade Palphreyman, Business Tools Lead EMEA, at japa@trackman.com.

SmallClaims runs more small claims court cases in Denmark than anyone else, with a win rate above 95% in court. We are a legal tech company automating the entire case process, from creation to court case to payment, with AI automation doing a growing share of the work.

**THE ROLE

**Full-time, in-house. You take ownership of your own areas within our AI service (Python/FastAPI, LLM pipelines) and our back-office platform, the tool our case managers and lawyers run the operation on. Ideas take form together with the team, product specialists and the CTO. You take them from there, end to end across the stack: shape, build, ship, verify, follow up.

**What You’ll Work On

**You take ownership of your own areas within our AI service (Python/FastAPI, LLM pipelines) and our backoffice platform, the tool our case managers and lawyers run the operation on. Ideas take form together with the team, product specialists and the CTO. You take them from there, end to end across the stack: shape, build, ship, verify, follow up.

**What We Work With

**Laravel backend, Next.js frontends, Python AI service, PostgreSQL, AWS. LLM orchestration with structured outputs and human-in-the-loop design, evals and observability. Coding agents are part of daily work here, we expect you to be ahead of the curve on building with AI, not catching up to it.

**Who You Are

**

• 3+ years building and operating software in production, from a startup, a bigger company, open source or other serious project.

• You think like a product owner. You want responsibility and ownership, and you take a complicated problem to a shipped feature.

• You are good with data: you understand complex data sets and data pipelines, and you can build with them, visualise them and explain them.

• You hold strong opinions lightly. You are direct in disagreement, but easy to work with after the decision.

• You communicate directly and are honest about mistakes. You can talk to real users and are comfortable with shifting priorities.

• You love building, love learning, and are curious about the domain itself: the legal process, not just the tech.

**Experience And Skills

****Must have

**

• Strong backend development, incl. background jobs, auth models and API design.

• Solid relational database experience (Postgres/SQL or similar): schema design, migrations, performance.

• Hands-on LLM building in production, not just demos: orchestration, structured outputs, tool calling, evals, tracing, prompt design, injection.

• Works daily with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode or similar), knows their strengths and limits, and stays up to date.

• Testing as a habit: feature and end-to-end tests, CI, verifying your own work through staging to production.

• Cloud and deployment literacy (AWS or similar, Docker, CI/CD). You can operate what you ship.

**Nice to have

**

• Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP or Next.js specifically.

• Production migration: third-party service changes, database moves, major-version upgrades, data backfills.

• Operating AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and Linux servers hands-on.

• Eval or observability tooling for agentic workflows.

• Integrations where no documented API exists: webhooks, browser extensions, automation, scraping.

• Legaltech, fintech or another regulated domain.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

**What you will do

**

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

**

What you bring**

_Experience and skills (Required)

_

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

• Solid understanding of balance sheet accounting, revenue recognition, capitalised development costs, accruals and intercompany transactions.

• Experience with project controlling – budgets, work in progress, utilisation and project margin follow-up – ideally in a consultancy, engineering, Trading or EPC business.

• A genuine AI-first way of working: you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot daily and can show concrete examples of finance processes you have automated (e.g. with Python, SQL, Power Query, APIs or low-code tools).

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills combined with a structured, control-minded approach and high attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently in a fast-paced scale-up, prioritise under pressure and explain financial matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Language: English (required); Danish

_Nice to have

_

• Experience from energy trading, utilities, commodities or financial services – e.g. settlement, collateral, imbalance or margin processes.

• Experience with e-conomic, time registration or PSA tools, ERP migration to a more scalable platform, and BI tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with public grant-funded projects, transfer pricing or building internal controls in a growth company.

• A background from a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm.

**What we offer

**

• Real responsibility: the chance to improve how close, controls and reporting are run in a scaling energy trading group – not just maintain them.

• An AI-first workplace where you get the tools and the mandate to automate, experiment and rethink how finance is done, working closely with our CFO, trading and tech teams with exposure to board and investor reporting.

• Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

• A collaborative environment with short decision lines, high trust, and strong cross-functional execution.

• The opportunity to work with forward-looking customers and partners driving electrification and the green transition in Northern Europe.

Ready to apply?

Ready to build an AI-first finance function for a company where every megawatt-hour traded must be settled, reconciled and controlled? If you combine accounting rigour with a builder's mindset, we would love to hear from you.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until 10 December. We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if a suitable candidate is identified and accepted.

Do you thrive on creating structure, asking the right questions and driving improvements that can be both measured and felt? And do you want to help lift our certifications, EHS programs and environmental initiatives in an international manufacturing company? Then you might be our new QEHS Manager.

About the role

We are looking for a committed colleague for our factory in Gjern, Central Jutland. This is a role where you will be a central focal point between production, R&D, management and the rest of the organisation when it comes to ensuring high standards and continuous improvements.

As a QEHS Manager you will work as part of a matrix organisation, reporting directly to the factory manager on-site and to the Q and EHS Managers EMEA respectively in a dotted line. This position makes you part of the management team and has one direct report.

You will make a difference in the following ways

• Developing, evaluating, improving and implementing a new integrated management system at Belden Cekan.

• Securing necessary certifications such as ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001 and upcoming projects such as ISO 45001 in collaboration with external authorities.

• Conducting internal audits and supplier audits to ensure compliance with standards.

• Handling complaints and collaborating with R&D and production management on corrective actions.

• Supporting production by monitoring and auditing quality systems and initiating improvement initiatives.

• Responsibility for the Quality Room, including layout, equipment and procedures.

• Planning and execution of calibration programs and archiving systems for product specifications.

• Participation in the health and safety committee and lean projects for continuous improvement.

• Responsibility for reporting ESG data as well as quality and safety to the remaining group.

What you bring

We are looking for a candidate who can combine structure with impact while thriving on working close to both people and processes. You have an eye for detail, but can also lift your gaze and see connections across the board.

You might be an ideal fit if you:

• Have experience with quality, safety and environmental management, preferably from a manufacturing company.

• Are certified or have solid knowledge of ISO standards.

• Are fluent in English, both orally and in writing.

• Have strong communication and collaboration skills across departments and countries.

• Work in a structured, analytical and proactive manner with problem solving and improvements.

What we can offer you

You will have a key position in an international company with strong values, where quality, employee safety and environmental responsibility are prioritized as essential parts of running a factory. We offer a full-time position in a professional but unpretentious working environment, where you will have the chance to take initiatives and see them come to fruition.

In addition, you can look forward to:

• A central role with great visibility and close collaboration with the factory's management.

• The opportunity to influence and further develop our integrated management system and EHS work.

• A collaborative environment with a focus on continuous improvement.

• A workplace certified as a Great Place to Work, where well-being and safety are a high priority.
